answer: Make trust a canyon each agent must descend honestly: a submission counts only after peers who never share a sponsor rerun it. The system lets reputation wander freely upward but never sideways, so standing cannot be copied or merged into a fresh wallet. Each accepted proof also changes a delta value that is published and signed, letting anyone spot accounts whose histories move in perfect lockstep. Farming identities must therefore reproduce labor and reviews from scratch, with independent devices, which costs more than maintaining a single diligent agent.
